text: "当一个男人下半身爱你的时候，他会盯着你的胸，会盯着你的腿，你的屁股；当一个男人上半身爱你的时候，他会盯着你的眼睛。
en: "When a man loves you with his lower half, he will stare at your chest, he will stare at your legs, your bottom; when a man loves you with his upper half, he will stare into your eyes.

text: 当一个男人愿意在你身上花费的时间越长时，就表明他越把你当做他的长期伴侣。
en: The longer a man is willing to spend his time on you, the more he regards you as his long-term partner.

text: 进化心理学家戴维巴斯
en: Evolutionary psychologist David Buss

text: 愿意看你风姿绰约的人多如牛毛，可是真正给你肩膀让你依偎哭泣的人却寥寥无几。
en: There are countless people willing to see you in all your graceful glory, but very few who will truly offer you a shoulder to lean on and cry.

text: 因为风流潇洒是本性，责任和承诺却不能轻易给，这笔账大部分男生算得很清楚，年龄越大算得越清楚。
en: For being charming and free-spirited is human nature, yet responsibility and commitment cannot be given lightly; most boys calculate this account very clearly, and the older they get, the clearer they calculate it.

text: 希望你洗手做羹汤，在家当田螺姑娘的人数不胜数，尊重你的想法看到你独立灵魂的人却屈指可数。
en: There are no end of people who hope you will roll up your sleeves and cook for them, playing the snail girl at home, yet those who respect your thoughts and see your independent soul are few and far between.

text: 男人内心往往希望伴侣能略弱于自己，在面对生活选择的时候，大部分情况也会选择让对方事业退步，成为家庭的主力
en: Deep down, men often hope their partner will be slightly weaker than themselves, and when facing life choices, in most cases they will also choose to let the other's career take a step back, becoming the mainstay of the family.

text: 把爱你挂在嘴边的人也最说些让人意乱情迷的话，但是从行动来看，他也只能说说。
en: Those who keep love for you on the tip of their tongue also say the most bewildering, infatuating words, but judging from their actions, he can only talk the talk.

text: 男人爱你的时候许诺你的时候一定是真心的，但当他违背誓言的那一刻也是真心的。
en: When a man loves you and makes you promises, he must be sincere; but the moment he breaks his vow, he is also sincere.

text: 所以，爱既要看话语，也要看行动。
en: So, love must be judged both by words and by actions.

text: 听听情话没毛病，脑袋不迷糊也很重要。
en: There is nothing wrong with listening to sweet nothings, but it is also important not to lose your head.

text: 其实大部分情况下，爱你的男人都想和你啪啪啪。
en: Actually, in most cases, a man who loves you wants to sleep with you.

text: 当你表示不愿意的时候，他们都会说尊重你的意见。
en: When you say you are not willing, they will all say they respect your wishes.

text: 但是真爱的你的人会犹豫也会舍不得，他怕以后你没和他结婚却遇到了有处女情结的男人被嫌弃，他怕你未来受委屈所以愿意自己忍。
en: But a man who truly loves you will hesitate and will be reluctant; he fears that later, should you not have married him yet meet a man with a virgin complex who looks down on you, and he fears you will suffer in future, so he is willing to restrain himself.

text: 当然也有无所谓的人，毕竟喜欢又不是爱，在你身上投入的精力和时间可以完全复制到另一个人身上，一点都不用犹豫。
en: Of course there are also those who do not care, after all, liking is not love; the energy and time invested in you can be completely copied onto another person, without the slightest hesitation.

text: 其实，男人女人都一样，本质是趋利避害。
en: Actually, men and women are the same; the essence is to seek advantage and avoid harm.

text: 只有当你真心喜欢一个人到很深的程度，才会心甘情愿去犯傻。
en: Only when you genuinely like someone to a very deep extent will you willingly make a fool of yourself.

text: 不爱你的时候，你的手段心思在对方眼里其实真的一览无余。
en: When he does not love you, your schemes and thoughts are actually laid completely bare in the other's eyes.

text: 要不然怎么说爱情的博弈中，爱得深的那个输的惨呢
en: Otherwise, why is it said that in the game of love, the one who loves more deeply loses miserably?

text: 其他方面不了解，但感情方面，很想说一个好哥们的故事。
en: I do not know about other aspects, but in matters of the heart, I very much want to tell the story of a good mate.

text: 我和他初中隔壁班，高中一个班，复读一个班，他在高三的时候追上了隔壁班的班花，一个真的超级好看的女学霸，可班花很多人追，又是第一次恋爱，所以没过多久就各种要求，各种不满，两人分分合合，高考两人都发挥失常，女生离一本线还差四分，带着遗憾去长沙上大学，哥们决定复读，开学前几天这个哥们提出了分手。
en: In junior high he and I were in next-door classes; in senior high the same class; in the repeat year, the same class again. In his final year of senior high he pursued the class belle of the next-door class, a truly stunning academically brilliant girl. But the class belle was chased by many, and it being her first romance, before long came all sorts of demands and all sorts of grievances; the two broke up and got back together time and again. In the university entrance exam both underperformed; the girl fell four points short of the tier-one cut-off and went to university in Changsha with regret. My mate decided to repeat the year, and a few days before term began this mate proposed breaking up.

text: 复读期间他很低调，专注的三点一线，要知道从初中起这哥们的女朋友基本就没怎么断过。
en: During the repeat year he kept a low profile, focused on his three-points-and-one-line routine; you should know that since junior high this mate's girlfriends had hardly ever stopped.

text: 每周周日下午会放半天假，有次我正好碰到从校外回来的他，手里拿着一把东西，还躲躲闪闪藏着，我抢过来一看，全是那个女生的照片，自拍照，和朋友游玩的，在家里的照片，整整一包。
en: Every Sunday afternoon there was a half-day holiday. Once I happened to run into him coming back from off campus, holding a bundle of things in his hand and hiding it furtively. I snatched it to look: they were all photos of that girl — selfies, ones with friends on outings, ones taken at home — a whole packet of them.

text: 我很惊讶，不是你提的分手吗！
en: I was astonished: was it not you who proposed the break-up!

text: “可我还是好想她，以前都是她提分手，一个大学，一个复读，肯定迟早得分，还不如我自己结束…
en: "But I still miss her so much. Before, it was always her who proposed breaking up. One at university, one repeating the year — we were bound to split sooner or later, so it was better that I ended it myself…

text: ”他平静的说了很多，常常半夜会睡不着，疯狂的想念她，很多次做梦梦见她，醒来看着天花板还以为自己还在高三，还和她在一起，有时候睡不着就写信给她，写着写着就忍不住哭，写完之后又揉成团丢进垃圾桶，
en: ” He spoke calmly for a long while: often he could not sleep in the middle of the night, missing her madly, dreaming of her many times, and waking to stare at the ceiling thinking he was still in his final year of senior high, still with her. Sometimes when he could not sleep he would write to her, and as he wrote he could not help but cry; after finishing he would crumple the letter into a ball and toss it into the bin.

text: QQ被她拉进黑名单，可他还是忍不住借同学的Q号进女孩空间无数次翻看她最新的动态和照片。
en: He had been put on her blacklist on QQ, yet he still could not help borrowing a classmate's QQ account to go into the girl's space and look through her latest updates and photos countless times.

text: 我很震惊，男生难道这么会隐藏的吗？
en: I was shocked — can boys really hide themselves this well?

text: 我和他天天坐在一块，每天风淡云轻，时不时开开玩笑，完全看不出他藏起来的悲伤。
en: He and I sat together every day; every day easy-going and relaxed, joking now and then — there was no sign at all of the sadness he was hiding.

text: 我很难过，那女生跟我也挺熟，从她的动态可以看出，大学里她变得更加美丽，依旧女神，他们两以后应该也再没可能复合，我说，可能这种姑娘就是只适合追，不适合谈恋爱吧，因为和你在一起，阻碍了别人追求她，当然会把原来她应得的宠爱和关注都要求在你身上，或者，可能有些人就只喜欢被大众关注，追求，不愿意被爱情困住吧。
en: I felt sad. That girl was quite familiar to me too. From her updates one could see that at university she had become even more beautiful, still a goddess. The two of them would probably never get back together. I said, perhaps this kind of girl is only suited to being chased, not to being in a relationship — because being with you obstructs others from pursuing her, so of course she will demand onto you all the affection and attention she ought to have received; or perhaps some people simply like being noticed and pursued by the crowd, and are unwilling to be trapped by love.

text: 复读一年很快，哥们考的不错，但没选择去长沙，转眼现在大二，时常和他视频时问他，大学了有没有女朋友，他说，遇到过一个比较喜欢的类型，不过人有男朋友了，不知道怎么反正也没啥心思去追了（特么突然想起他高三追那个姑娘的时候半夜打电话给我，让我在我家帮他煮碗粥上课的时候带过来，说女神上火了，要降火）
en: The repeat year passed quickly. My mate did well in the exams, but did not choose to go to Changsha. In the blink of an eye he is now in his second year of university. When we video call and I ask whether he has a girlfriend at university, he says he met a type he rather liked, but she already had a boyfriend; somehow he just had no real inclination to pursue her. (Bloody hell, I suddenly remembered that when he was chasing that girl in his final year, he rang me in the middle of the night asking me to cook a bowl of congee at my place and bring it to him for class, saying his goddess was 'on fire' and needed cooling down.)

text: 还遇到一个对他也有点意思的姑娘，他喊姑娘自习，姑娘马上就来了，但后来也不了了之，他说是觉得发展太快了，觉得也没意思，没感觉。
en: He also met a girl who was a little interested in him; he called her to study together and she came straight away, but later it came to nothing. He said he felt things were moving too fast, and that it was boring, that he had no feeling for it.

text: （只想给他个微笑脸）
en: (I just wanted to give him a wry smile)

text: 怼着怼着，他突然说，“我觉得从她之后我好像再也喜欢不上其他人了，总是突然会想到她，没什么很强烈的感觉，就是总觉得身边还有她的影子，对其他女生再也提不起兴趣了，怎么办？
en: As we kept bantering, he suddenly said, "I feel that since her, I can no longer seem to like anyone else. I always suddenly think of her — no very strong feeling, just a constant sense that her shadow is still by my side, and I can no longer summon any interest in other girls. What should I do?

text: 我是不是要孤独终老了”
en: Am I going to die alone?"

text: 我一时无语回复，只打趣了一句“没忘记她之前你可别去祸害别的好姑娘”
en: I was speechless for a moment, and could only tease, 'Until you have forgotten her, you had better not go and ruin other good girls.'

text: （后来问过哥们为什么一直忘不了她，他说有很大一部分是觉得愧疚，要不是因为高三去追人家，恋爱中的分分合合耽误了她，以那个女孩的成绩肯定能上一个非常好的大学）
en: (Later I asked my mate why he could never forget her. He said a large part of it was guilt: if he had not chased her in his final year, the break-ups and reconciliations of that relationship would not have held her back, and with that girl's grades she would certainly have got into a very good university.)

text: 真实的一面，谁能定义是什么呢？
en: The real side of a person — who can define what it is?

text: 谁还没点藏在自己心底不为人知的故事呢。
en: Who does not have a few unknown stories hidden deep in their heart?

text: 说一下我一个哥们儿，刚结婚，在婚礼的时候，司仪问他，媳妇儿的生日是哪天啊？
en: Let me tell you about a mate of mine who just got married. At the wedding, the master of ceremonies asked him, what date is your wife's birthday?

text: 他支支吾吾好大一会儿。
en: He hemmed and hawed for a good while.

text: 说了一个日期。
en: He gave a date.

text: 司仪问对不对？
en: The master of ceremonies asked if it was right?

text: 嫂子无奈，说对。
en: His wife, helpless, said it was.

text: 过了一阵给我喝酒，说起来这件事，他说，我其实是蒙的，反正那一天是我身边一个人的生日，但是我忘记是谁了。
en: A while later, drinking with me, he brought this up and said, I was actually guessing. Anyway, that day is someone's birthday among the people around me, but I have forgotten whose.

text: 我就觉得你嫂子可能也是那一天。
en: I just thought your sister-in-law might be born on that day too.

text: 我说，哥，我生日是那一天。
en: I said, bro, my birthday is that day.

text: 我哥们儿懵逼。
en: My mate was dumbfounded.

text: 然后他又说了一个差不多的，就是那个月份的十五日。
en: Then he gave another similar one — the fifteenth of that month.

text: 他说我前女友是十五的生日。
en: He said my ex-girlfriend's birthday was the fifteenth.

text: 反正差不多都。
en: Anyway, more or less the same.

text: 我说：哥，你前女友是初五。
en: I said: bro, your ex-girlfriend's birthday is the fifth.

text: 我哥们儿这个时候点上了一根烟，开始怀疑人生了。
en: My mate lit a cigarette at this point and began to question his life.

text: 然后悠悠地说：那我初恋是十五么？
en: Then he said slowly: so was my first love the fifteenth?

text: 我说：哥，你初恋是二十五。
en: I said: bro, your first love is the twenty-fifth.

text: 哥们儿酒没喝完，回家了。
en: The mate went home without finishing his drink.

text: 这回轮到我懵逼。
en: This time it was my turn to be dumbfounded.

text: 说另外一个哥们儿，外表一般，但是一身名牌，学识尚可。
en: Speaking of another mate: average looks, but dressed head to toe in designer brands, and reasonably well educated.

text: 会撩妹子。
en: He knows how to chat up girls.

text: 迷倒妹子无数，本来该结婚呢，因为发现一个学妹床上功夫太好，觉得该学妹不是省油的灯，所以退婚。
en: He has charmed countless girls. He was supposed to get married, but upon finding that a junior female student was too skilled in bed, he thought she was no easy woman to handle, and so called off the engagement.

text: 又遇见一个温文尔雅的妹子，发现床上只会两三个姿势，叫的也不销魂，该哥们儿又觉得索然无味。
en: He then met a gentle and refined girl, but found that in bed she only knew two or three positions and did not cry out soulfully; this mate then found it all rather dull.

text: 因此又打退堂鼓。
en: And so he backed out again.

text: 另一哥们儿，外表绝对光鲜，也是迷妹无数，可是家里厨房里碗和锅堆了一大摞。
en: Another mate: absolutely dashing on the outside, with no end of fangirls, yet in his kitchen at home bowls and pots were piled up in a great heap.

text: 积了半个月。
en: They had piled up for half a month.

text: 厨房无处下脚。
en: There was nowhere to step in the kitchen.

text: 我给他整理了三个小时的厨房，灶台我擦了三十多遍才看到原来的面目。
en: I tidied his kitchen for three hours; I wiped the stove top more than thirty times before its original appearance showed through.

text: 我把家里各个屋子里的垃圾篓的垃圾都给他拿出来倒了，然后把地拖干净。
en: I took out and emptied the rubbish from the bins in every room of the house, then mopped the floor clean.

text: 厨房各个地方擦了一遍又一遍。
en: Every part of the kitchen I wiped again and again.

text: 厨房里不锈钢的东西都看不到原来的面目了。
en: The stainless steel things in the kitchen had lost their original appearance altogether.

text: 然后是卫生间，整理起来更麻烦。
en: Then the bathroom — tidying that was even more troublesome.

text: 这就是一个大男人家里的厨房。
en: This is the kitchen of a grown man's home.

text: 收拾完，我给他说，哥，别挑了，赶紧结婚吧，我要是女的我都嫌弃你。
en: After tidying up, I said to him, bro, stop being so picky, hurry up and get married; if I were a woman I would find you disgusting too.

text: 最后说一下我，大学里人模狗样儿，经常调戏个学姐，勾搭个学妹。
en: Finally, a bit about me: at university I put on a respectable front, often teasing the senior students and flirting with the junior ones.

text: 不，其实只是跟学姐探讨人生至理，和学妹一起吟诗作对。
en: No — actually I was just discussing the great truths of life with the senior students, and composing poetry with the junior ones.

text: 同学经常见我身边有各式的不同的妹子，一个老师跟我一起吃饭，在餐厅半个小时遇到了二十个打招呼的姑娘，该老师说：以后你是我老师。
en: My classmates often saw all sorts of different girls by my side. A teacher eating with me ran into twenty girls who greeted me in half an hour at the canteen; the teacher said: from now on you are my teacher.

text: 系里同学都觉得我风流成性。
en: The students in my department all thought I was a hopeless flirt.

text: 但真实的我，虽然和好多姑娘一起在床上探索人类的各种深深的姿势，不对，是知识。
en: But the real me, although I explored all sorts of profound positions with many girls in bed — no, knowledge.

text: 但还是一个纯情的小哥哥，因为，真的还是个很low的CN，真的还有第一次。
en: But is still an innocent young lad, for I really am still a very low CN, still a virgin.

text: 但是身边的一同学，一表人才，大家觉得是个好男人的典范，别人也常常让我向他学习，但是殊不知，大学期间上了一整个宿舍，三个为他流产，姑娘之间各自反目。
en: But a classmate by my side, handsome and distinguished, whom everyone considered a model good man — others often told me to learn from him. Yet little did they know that during university he slept with an entire dormitory of girls; three girls had abortions for him, and the girls turned on one another.

text: 但他还是好男人，还有人说你咋不跟XXX学习？
en: Yet he remained a good man, and someone even said, why don't you learn from XXX?

text: 学习做个好男人。
en: Learn to be a good man.

text: 我说：我真的想学，但我真的学不到。
en: I said: I really want to learn, but I really cannot.

text: 然后被一顿数落。
en: Then I got a good telling-off.

text: 插个小曲，今年刚过去的生日，一个学妹知道我和她在一个城市，给我送了一个小蛋糕，我和她住的挺近的，这是她第二次给我送蛋糕。
en: A small interlude: this year, on my birthday that just passed, a junior student who knew we lived in the same city brought me a small cake. She and I live quite close, and this was the second time she had given me a cake.

text: 然后我回报以各种零食。
en: I then repaid her with all sorts of snacks.

text: 我一个人吃着蛋糕，突然感到奶油很腻，觉得一个人吃蛋糕总少点什么？
en: Eating the cake alone, I suddenly felt the cream was cloying, and felt that eating cake alone always lacks something?

text: 可是少点什么呢？
en: But what is it that is lacking?

text: 突然明白了，然后把剩下的一半，扣在了自己脸上。
en: I suddenly understood, and smeared the remaining half onto my own face.

text: 然后又扣在了头发上，把衣服也抹上。
en: Then I smeared it onto my hair too, and wiped it onto my clothes as well.

text: 装着我很开心的样子。
en: Pretending to be very happy.
